name: persian-tools
title: Persian Tools
description: Fix text typed on the wrong keyboard layout (English and Persian), convert Persian digits to English, and convert Jalali (Shamsi) dates.
author: afshany

commands.name: fix-layout
commands.title: Fix Keyboard Layout
commands.subtitle: Persian Tools
commands.description: Convert text typed on the wrong keyboard layout between English (US) and Persian.

commands.name: fix-selection
commands.title: Fix Selected Text Layout
commands.subtitle: Persian Tools
commands.description: Replace the selected text with its English/Persian keyboard layout conversion.

commands.name: persian-digits
commands.title: Convert Persian Digits
commands.subtitle: Persian Tools
commands.description: Convert Persian and Arabic digits in text to English digits.

commands.name: jalali-date
commands.title: Jalali Date
commands.subtitle: Persian Tools
commands.description: Convert between Jalali (Shamsi) and Gregorian dates and see how far away a date is.
